events.text:
Built a compact 3-cell organizer: bases at 0,0, 1,0 and 0,1. Cell 0,0 holds a full-depth bin for pens, cells 0,1 and 1,0 have plain covers providing a flat top surface. Staged with props on the covers and in the bin.

**Build verification:** check_build meshClash: clear. Warning LOOSE_BODY noted – bodies would benefit from joint bolts but configurator allows placement.

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Few bases forming small desk organizer | met | 3x piece:full at 0,0,0 + 1,0,0 + 0,1,0 – modest footprint |
| Bin for pens | met | bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full in cell 0,0,0 |
| Covered top to stand things on | met | cover:0,1,0;full;top and cover:1,0,0;full;top provide flat top surfaces |
| Dressed with mug on top | met | prop:mug on cover:1,0,0;full;top |
| Dressed with phone on top | met | prop:phone on cover:0,1,0;full;top |
| Dressed with pen in bin | met | prop:pen on bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full (dryRun confirmed fit, then placed) |

Props are staging only and not part of the BOM.
